name: Oneview Healthcare PLC
summary: Oneview Healthcare PLC develops and sells software services for the healthcare sector in Ireland, the United States, Australia, the Middle East, and Asia. The company provides patient experience, care team experience, and health system and hospital solutions; and system integrations for HER/EMP/PAS, virtual care, interpretations, middleware, clinical communications, dietary, IoT: RTLS and building automation, patient education and portals, entertainment and gaming, calming and distraction, and consumer streaming and social. It also offers secure software development lifecycles, data classification, and third-party penetration testing services. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
